messages:
nora_sre: Short wrap-up from the postmortem follow-up meeting — collecting the final action owners and narrow timelines for GPU headroom and autoscale fixes. I'll keep the tracker up to date.

ashley_platform: I'll own the scheduler variant A/B (staggered pod admit + gentle scale-down). Running quick staging runs today, will post numbers.

devon_scheduler: I'll submit the quota request for the dedicated pool (us-west-2). Proposal: +5 GPUs split into +2 now, +3 after 10 days if headroom not met. Draft PR Thu.

maria_capacity: I'll run two sims: 1) current traffic w/ pre-warm=1, 2) shift batch window 03:00->05:00 UTC. Will attach CSVs and cost delta midday Wed.

ben_oncall: Ops will publish an "emergency scale" one-pager and a Slack workflow to trigger warmup. Also adding a short checklist for oncall to run before manual scale. ETA tomorrow.

priya_finance: Please include monthly delta and 30-day run-rate projection in the PR so finance can sign off quickly.

ops-bot: Created task INF-6001: "Scheduler AB + warmup workflow" (owner: ashley_platform) | due 2024-07-12

nora_sre: Owner summary + dates: scheduler AB @ashley_platform due 2024-07-12, quota PR @devon_scheduler due 2024-07-14, headroom sims @maria_capacity due 2024-07-10, ops playbook @ben_oncall due 2024-07-09, finance review @priya_finance due 2024-07-15.

ashley_platform: Canary plan: 8% -> 30% -> 100% over 48h. Health gates: 99th latency regression <5%, error rate <0.5%. Staging snippet I'm testing:
```
autoscaler:
  targetUtilization: 0.72
  preWarmGPUs: 1
  scaleDownDelaySeconds: 80
```

devon_scheduler: PR will include staged handout + rollback window and alerting for headroom <20%. Tagging finance in the PR.

maria_capacity: Early sim note: pre-warm=1 reduces 99th tail by ~22% during batch spikes; schedule shift to 05:00 UTC reduces peak by ~28% in sim. Uploading CSV: https://internal/reports/headroom-227001.csv

ben_oncall: Playbook added to ops-playbooks. Manual emergency commands and warmup workflow example:
```
/ops/warmup start --pool=dedi-us-west --units=2
kubectl wait --for=condition=ready pod -l app=inference -n redwood --timeout=300s
```
Also added Slack shortcut to trigger warmup-job.

priya_finance: If Maria's schedule-shift numbers hold, finance prefers moving batch windows to avoid permanent quota increases. I'll model cost vs reliability and post results.

nora_sre: Two follow-ups: 1) Maria include a 30-day cost comparison for pre-warm vs quota increase; 2) Devon include alert rules and escrow expiry in PR. Keep links and canary logs in this thread. We'll review progress in 6 days.

ashley_platform: Will post staging runs + canary job link here once ready.

maria_capacity: CSV and cost model by Wed midday.

ben_oncall: Playbook and shortcut live. Scheduled monthly headroom report job.

ops-bot: Created task INF-6002: "Quota PR 802 review" (owner: devon_scheduler) | due 2024-07-14

nora_sre: Thanks team — this should close the immediate postmortem follow-ups. Reopen if anything changes.
